item.title: Plant Diversity Jumps On Rewilded Farm: species on ex-arable plots leap fourfold; survey shows rapid gains
item.description: Wild Ken Hill’s groundbreaking rewilding initiative revealed a remarkable surge in plant diversity, with species nearly doubling within just three years. This transformation of former arable land led to a fourfold increase in plant variety, predominantly fueled by grazing animals that enhanced the ecosystem's structure. The surge in vegetation signals promising benefits for local insect and bird populations, showcasing nature's impressive capacity for rejuvenation. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
